verdict.rationale: Dover's docs say users can set up an interview plan and collect structured feedback from every interviewer, which directly covers the core idea of a defined interview plan. However, this is a single thin help-center summary line. It does not establish that plans are attached per role, broken into stages, or reusable across roles. Missing for 10: documented question banks, per-interviewer focus areas or scorecard assignments, stage-level plan configuration, define-once-and-reuse templates across roles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused

citations.quote: Set up your interview plan, schedule candidates, and collect structured feedback from every interviewer.
